```text
import { useContext, useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import {
  ColorPicker as AriaColorPicker,
  ColorPickerStateContext,
  ColorSwatch as AriaColorSwatch,
  ColorSwatchPicker as AriaColorSwatchPicker,
  ColorSwatchPickerItem,
  Dialog,
  DialogTrigger,
  parseColor,
} from 'react-aria-components';
import type {
  ColorPickerProps as AriaColorPickerProps,
  ColorSwatchProps,
} from 'react-aria-components';

import { css } from '@emotion/css';

import { ColorPreview } from './ColorPreview';
import { Input } from './Input';
import { Popover } from './Popover';
import { theme } from './theme';
import { View } from './View';

function ColorSwatch(props: ColorSwatchProps) {
  return (
    <AriaColorSwatch
      {...props}
      style={({ color }) => ({
        background: color.toString('hex'),
        width: '32px',
        height: '32px',
        borderRadius: '4px',
        boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)',
      })}
    />
  );
}

const DEFAULT_COLOR_SET = [
  '#690CB0',
  '#D32F2F',
  '#C2185B',
  '#7B1FA2',
  '#512DA8',
  '#303F9F',
  '#1976D2',
  '#0288D1',
  '#0097A7',
  '#00796B',
  '#388E3C',
  '#689F38',
  '#AFB42B',
  '#FBC02D',
  '#FFA000',
  '#F57C00',
  '#E64A19',
  '#5D4037',
  '#616161',
  '#455A64',
  '#FF6666', //red
  '#FF99FF', //magenta
  '#C39DDF', //purple
  '#6666FF', //blue
  '#B2FFFF', //cyan
  '#99cb99', //green
  '#FFFF7F', //yellow
  '#FFAB66', //orange
  '#D4B89C', //brown
  '#BFBFBF', //gray
  '#FFAEAE', //colors repeat from above with a lighter tint
  '#FFCCFF',
  '#E4D4FF', //this is now purple125
  '#B0B0FF',
  '#D8FFFF',
  '#CFE5CF',
  '#FFFFB2',
  '#FFD5B3',
  '#E4D3C3',
  '#DADADA',
];

type ColorSwatchPickerProps = {
  columns?: number;
  colorset?: string[];
};

function ColorSwatchPicker({
  columns = 5,
  colorset = DEFAULT_COLOR_SET,
}: ColorSwatchPickerProps) {
  const pickers = [];

  for (let l = 0; l < colorset.length / columns; l++) {
    const pickerItems = [];

    for (let c = 0; c < columns; c++) {
      const color = colorset[columns * l + c];
      if (!color) {
        break;
      }

      pickerItems.push(
        <ColorSwatchPickerItem
          key={color}
          color={color}
          className={css({
            position: 'relative',
            outline: 'none',
            borderRadius: '4px',
            width: 'fit-content',
            forcedColorAdjust: 'none',
            cursor: 'pointer',

            '&[data-selected]::after': {
              content: '""',
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              border: '2px solid black',
              outline: '2px solid white',
              outlineOffset: '-4px',
              borderRadius: 'inherit',
            },
          })}
        >
          <ColorSwatch />
        </ColorSwatchPickerItem>,
      );
    }

    pickers.push(
      <AriaColorSwatchPicker
        key={`colorset-${l}`}
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          gap: '8px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
        }}
      >
        {pickerItems}
      </AriaColorSwatchPicker>,
    );
  }

  return pickers;
}
const isHexDigits = (value: string) => /^[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(value);

function HexColorField() {
  const state = useContext(ColorPickerStateContext);
  const currentDigits = state?.color.toString('hex').slice(1) ?? '';
  const [digits, setDigits] = useState(currentDigits);
  const [syncedDigits, setSyncedDigits] = useState(currentDigits);

  // Pick up changes made outside this field, e.g. clicking a swatch
  if (currentDigits !== syncedDigits) {
    setSyncedDigits(currentDigits);
    if (currentDigits.toLowerCase() !== digits.toLowerCase()) {
      setDigits(currentDigits);
    }
  }

  const onChangeValue = (value: string) => {
    const nextDigits = value.replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, '').slice(0, 6);
    setDigits(nextDigits);

    if (isHexDigits(nextDigits)) {
      const color = parseColor(`#${nextDigits}`);
      if (color) {
        state?.setColor(color);
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
      <View style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
        <span
          aria-hidden="true"
          style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            left: 6,
            top: '50%',
            transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
            color: theme.formInputTextPlaceholder,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
          }}
        >
          #
        </span>
        <Input
          aria-label="Hex color"
          placeholder="RRGGBB"
          value={digits}
          onChangeValue={onChangeValue}
          onBlur={() => setDigits(currentDigits)}
          style={{ width: 100, paddingLeft: 16 }}
        />
      </View>
      <ColorPreview color={isHexDigits(digits) ? `#${digits}` : null} />
    </View>
  );
}

type ColorPickerProps = {
  children?: ReactNode;
  columns?: number;
  colorset?: string[];
  /** Optional content at the bottom of the popover, e.g. a "Remove color" button */
  footer?: ReactNode;
} & AriaColorPickerProps;

export function ColorPicker({
  children,
  columns,
  colorset,
  footer,
  ...props
}: ColorPickerProps) {
  return (
    <AriaColorPicker defaultValue={props.defaultValue ?? '#690CB0'} {...props}>
      <DialogTrigger>
        {children}
        <Popover>
          <Dialog
            style={{
              outline: 'none',
              padding: '15px',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              gap: '8px',
              minWidth: '192px',
              maxHeight: 'inherit',
              boxSizing: 'border-box',
              overflow: 'auto',
            }}
          >
            <ColorSwatchPicker columns={columns} colorset={colorset} />
            <HexColorField />
          </Dialog>
        </Popover>
      </DialogTrigger>
    </AriaColorPicker>
  );
}
```
</details></tool-use>

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-29 14:25:42Z)**_

I fixed it with a new commit's worth of changes on top of your merge instead of reverting it. Your merge was mostly right. Two of its conflict resolutions kept only master's side, and that fix is two lines.

**What broke**

1. **[TransactionsTable.tsx:141](packages/desktop-client/src/components/transactions/TransactionsTable.tsx#L141)**: this was the CI failure. Your branch and master each added an import on the same line, and the resolution kept only master's `scaledIconSize` import. That dropped `import { isHexColor } from '#util/colorPill'`, which caused both the typecheck error (TS2304) and the lint error (`no-undef`).
2. **[ColorPicker.tsx:241](packages/component-library/src/ColorPicker.tsx#L241)**: CI didn't catch this one. Master replaced the hex input block with a new `<HexColorField />`, and the `{footer}` line your branch had added in that block was lost. The prop was still accepted but never shown, so the "Remove color" button in `AccountColorButton` disappeared.

`Header.tsx` was merged correctly; both sides' changes are there.

**Why I didn't revert the merge**
- Reverting a merge commit with `git revert` causes trouble later: when you merge master again, git treats master's changes as already handled and won't bring them back.
- Resetting and redoing the merge would mean force-pushing, and the merge is already on `origin`.
- Either way you'd end up with the same files as this fix.

**Checks**
- `yarn typecheck` and oxlint pass, and the two edited files are formatted correctly.
- The ColorPicker tests pass (6), and the account, color and transaction tests pass (87, 1 skipped).
- When you run `yarn lint` locally, you'll still see about 495 "format issues". That comes from Windows line endings in your checkout (about 780 files are stored with LF but checked out with CRLF), not from this branch. CI checks out LF, so it won't flag them.

The changes are uncommitted. Want me to commit them (`[AI] Fix merge resolution: restore isHexColor import and ColorPicker footer`) and push?
